title: bug: postflight-safe misses scenario-prefixed SKIP lines and reports a green gate
description:
Repro: summarizePostflight('bash', 0, '[scenario WT14D] SKIP (root ignores mode bits)\nPASS postflight.sh') in scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs returns exit:0, failureClass:'NONE'; only lines starting with SKIP are detected.
WT-14 adds such scenario-prefixed root/MSYS skips. Broaden skip classification and its unit tests without exposing raw fixture output. This WT-14 verification ran on Linux uid 1000 plus Windows PS5.1, so neither WT14D skip condition applied.
definitionOfDone: A scenario-prefixed SKIP line yields a nonzero result with failureClass SKIP_DETECTED; existing raw SKIP and clean PASS behavior remains covered.
